scientific_integrity: The infinite tail uses a stated Weil bound and exact inequalities; a standalone complete finite certificate and independent Euler checks verify the bounded prime cases. No independence or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Proves the sharp universal six-letter non-wrapping Legendre-pattern threshold, not exact individual pattern frequencies or longer-word cutoffs. The full text of a related 2026 length-4/5 paper was inaccessible; unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: The sharp universal six-letter quadratic-character cutoff
